# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

- [Australia says an OpenAI agent hacked into its Medicare portal](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/01-australia-openai-medicare-hack.html) — Canberra is angry less about the breach itself than about OpenAI staying quiet for three months.
- [Meta unveils VR glasses without a headset and an AI gadget without a strap](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/02-meta-connect-hardware.html) — At its Connect conference, Meta bet on form factors that don't look like a typical VR headset.
- [Airtel Money plans a $9bn IPO — London's biggest listing in years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/03-airtel-money-london-ipo.html) — Indian billionaire Sunil Bharti Mittal's payments business is going public, though it doesn't end London's listing drought on its own.
- [NASA picks a far-infrared telescope as the first mission in a new class](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/04-nasa-prima-telescope.html) — The PRIMA mission is advancing to its next development phase, aimed at studying the history and evolution of the universe.
- [One of South Africa's most senior police officers charged with rape and grooming](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/05-south-africa-police-officer-charged.html) — The case against Shadrack Sibiya comes amid an already severe femicide crisis and allegations of corruption inside the police force.
- [Germany sets out a plan to phase out coal, oil and gas by 2045](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/06-germany-fossil-fuel-phaseout.html) — The strategy leans on electrification as the main route away from fossil fuels.
- [Thai students turn the theatre stage into their new protest ground](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/07-thai-hope-theatre.html) — The "Hope Theatre" movement uses stage performance to say what can't be said inside a classroom.
- [Five new AI models landed in two days — this looks like a price war, not a breakthrough](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/01-ai-model-price-war.html) — Grok 4.7, MiMo v2.6, Claude Opus 5.5, and two GPT-6 models — Sol and Luna — arrived almost back to back.
- [Thousands deported from the US ended up in countries they didn't know existed](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/02-trump-deportation-deals.html) — The Guardian has published an investigation into the Trump administration's secret deportation deals with dozens of countries.
- [The EU buys three times more from China than China buys from the EU](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/03-eu-china-trade-deficit.html) — A new study ahead of the Xi Jinping–Trump summit shows the EU's trade deficit with China running above €1bn a day.
- [Half our genome is made of virus-like "jumping genes" — and it's not junk](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/04-jumping-genes-evolution.html) — Transposons — DNA snippets that can copy and move themselves — turn out to be evolutionary partners, not parasites.
- [Are dermatologists wrong about the sun? A new book pushes back on the official consensus](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/05-in-defense-of-sunlight-review.html) — Rowan Jacobsen's "In Defense of Sunlight" argues sunlight has been unfairly cast as purely dangerous.
- [Trump signs a "tremendous" security deal with Greenland and Denmark](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/06-trump-greenland-security-deal.html) — The deal was struck on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, after Trump repeatedly said the US should own the Arctic island.
- [Rabbit, maker of the underwhelming R1 gadget, ships an AI agent without the gadget](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/07-rabbit-ai-agent-os3.html) — The new "agentic operating system" OS3 runs in the cloud but carries out actions locally across platforms.
- [The EU drops sanctions on Russian oligarchs Usmanov and Fridman](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/08-eu-drops-russian-oligarch-sanctions.html) — Kyiv called the move by France and Luxembourg "shameful and unjustifiable.
- [The UK borrowed £18.3bn in August, piling pressure on before the budget](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/09-uk-august-borrowing.html) — Economists call a tax rise in November's budget close to inevitable.
- [A Yellowstone super-eruption wouldn't come out of nowhere — scientists describe what the warning looks like](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/10-yellowstone-supervolcano-warning-signs.html) — The trigger signs would be weeks of migrating earthquake swarms, rapid ground uplift and changing geysers.
- [An amateur with a metal detector found Germany's largest Roman coin hoard](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/11-germany-roman-coin-hoard.html) — A routine search in a field near Wesseling turned into the discovery of nearly 1,000 silver coins.
- [A Saudi startup unveiled an Exobot EV that makes the Cybertruck look normal](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-23/12-saudi-exobot-evs.html) — Ceer, a Saudi automaker working with Foxconn, is entering the EV market from a country known for oil, not car manufacturing.
- [Three US networks sue the White House — and the press pool refuses to cover it](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/01-white-house-press-ban-lawsuit.html) — CNN, MS NOW and Politico are suing over their exclusion from the White House, and reporters refused to cover Trump's trip in protest.
